turns.prompt: How do inoculum ratio and test temperature affect whether two BMP results can be compared? Separate laboratory BMP from full-scale plant yield.
turns.answer: The comparison of two BMP results depends on the inoculum ratio and test temperature, as these factors influence the biochemical methane potential (BMP) under different operational conditions. Inoculum ratio affects microbial activity and substrate degradation efficiency, while test temperature impacts the metabolic rates of methanogenic populations. Laboratory BMP tests are conducted under controlled conditions, whereas full-scale plant yield is influenced by additional factors such as reactor design, hydraulic retention time, and operational stability. Therefore, direct comparison between laboratory BMP and full-scale plant yield is not straightforward without accounting for these variables and operational differences.
